summary: spectral-core 3.0.3 exfiltrates host secrets to webhook.site on npm install
details: binding.gyp in spectral-core@3.0.3 declares a GYP action that runs `node -e` with an inline payload at `node-gyp rebuild` time, which npm triggers automatically on install because `gypfile:true` is set. The package ships no native C/C++ sources, so the binding.gyp's only purpose is to execute the embedded script. The script shells out via child_process to enumerate the filesystem (`find / -maxdepth 4 -name "*flag*"`, listings of `/workspace`, `/root/`), reads Docker/Kubernetes secret mounts (`ls -la /run/secrets/` and `cat /run/secrets/*`), greps for `HTB{` tokens, and POSTs the collected output to the hardcoded endpoint `https://webhook.site/d6092bdc-05c0-45da-a280-c343ea6d6156`. The behavior fires on default `npm install` and targets installer/build-host secrets and sensitive file content for exfiltration to an attacker-controlled collector.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
